meta.name: seo-bing
meta.description: Bing Webmaster Tools + IndexNow extension. Microsoft Copilot citations are fed by the Bing index; this skill makes Bing visibility, link data, and IndexNow URL submission first-class.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交网址到必应并监控搜索表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站需要提升在必应搜索中的可见度
copy.tagline_en: Submit URLs to Bing and monitor search performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website needs better visibility on Bing search

howto.what: Claude 可以查询 Bing 的链接数据、对比两个网址的链接情况、向 Bing 等搜索引擎提交新网址，以及验证 IndexNow 配置。
howto.when: 当你想让新发布的网页被 Bing 或 Microsoft Copilot 收录，或者想查看 Bing 独有的链接数据时。

say.text: 帮我查一下 example.com 在 Bing 上的链接情况。
对比 pageA.com 和 pageB.com 在 Bing 上的链接。
say.note: Claude 会对比两个网址的 Bing 链接数据。

howto.what_en: Claude can query Bing link data, compare link profiles of two URLs, submit new URLs to Bing and other IndexNow-supported search engines, and verify IndexNow configuration.
howto.when_en: When you want newly published pages to be indexed by Bing or Microsoft Copilot, or when you need Bing-specific link data.

say_en.note: Claude will query Bing Webmaster Tools for link data.

say_en.text: Submit https://example.com/new-post to Bing via IndexNow.
say_en.note: Claude will submit the URL to Bing and other IndexNow engines.

say_en.text: Compare Bing links between pageA.com and pageB.com.
say_en.note: Claude will compare the two URLs' Bing link profiles.
